In May 2016 the Archive published Anatoly Chernyaev's diary for 1976, in English for the first time. The edition includes Chernyaev's own later edits and a postscript by the author. That makes the volume two texts at once: the diary as written, and the diarist revisiting himself.

Chernyaev observed the Soviet leadership from inside the Central Committee across the Brezhnev years. His diaries became famous for their candor about colleagues and about his own disillusion. A year volume like 1976, before the famous Gorbachev period, shows the observer's eye already trained. Readers following the whole diary series can watch his judgments sharpen year by year.
